messages:
marie: Hey @payroll-team — I'm seeing a weird deduction on my 03/31 paystub. Two things showing up: 'GARNISHMENT - CA FAMILY SUPPORT' for $420 and a 'HMRC PAYE RECLAIM' for £150. I was on secondment in the UK until 2026-02-28 and returned to CA on 2026-03-05. Why did both apply? I'm not aware of any garnishment. (I'll DM the stub)
hr_payroll: Hi Marie — sorry you're seeing that. Please DM the paystub and your UK final docs (P45/P60 or final payslip). We'll triage with Payroll Ops. Don't post SSN here. :locked:
marie: DM sent with paystub and P45. Thanks.
payroll-bot: Payroll batch #202603 processed for 2026-03-31; notifications sent.
alex: @hr_payroll fyi this smells like two independent things: a post-term HMRC reclaim that came in after we closed the UK payroll, and a separate US garnishment match against your CA address. We'll need docs to prove the garnishment isn't yours.
sara-hr: @marie can you confirm any legal name changes or prior SSNs? Also did you ever have an arrangement with a prior employer that might have triggered a garnishment match?
marie: No name/SSN changes. Never had a garnishment before. The garnishment authority listed is 'CA FAMILY SUPPORT' but the case number doesn't match anything I know.
hr_payroll: Understood. Here's the plan: 1) Payroll Ops will research the garnishment source and served order 2) If garnishment is erroneous, we will reverse the deduction and reimburse on the next payroll cycle 3) We'll coordinate with UK payroll to handle the HMRC reclaim reversal if it's recoverable 4) Keep you updated within 5 business days. Does that work?
marie: That works — thank you.
alex: @finance_ops tagging for reversal/gross-up guidance. If HMRC reclaim was applied in error after final pay, UK payroll may need to file a reclaim or credit. If garnishment is erroneous, we should refund net + any bank fees/interest.
finance_ops: Noted. If confirmed erroneous we'll issue a one-time reimbursement (gross-up not required unless tax impact persists). We'll also open a finance ticket to track refunds and any tax reporting consequences.
marie: Uploaded court denial PDF (no relation) and my final UK payslip.
hr_payroll: Received. We'll escalate to Payroll Ops and Legal. @payroll-bot can you create an investigation ticket?
payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-2026 created: "Investigation - possible erroneous garnishment and HMRC reclaim" (linked to thread 1782005432)
alex: Payroll Ops: next actions for you — verify garnishment source (court docs), validate employee identity match, request stop/withdrawal if erroneous, and coordinate reversal entry for April payroll. Also contact UK payroll team to start reclaim process for the £150 if HMRC posted after termination.
payroll-bot: Note: Sensitive docs received and stored in People Ops secure bucket. Access limited to payroll/legal/people-ops.
sara-hr: Marie — we'll keep you looped. Expect first update by EOD +5 business days. Sorry for the stress.
marie: Thanks everyone, appreciate the help :pray:
